data.gender_notes: Juman is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root jamaana, meaning 'to bestow, to give'. Juman signifies the one who is gentle, gracious, and kind. The name Juman carries the meaning “Gentle, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juman usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, in the spiritually inclined perspective, the name Juman holds immense significance. As the name suggest, one who is known as Juman is thought to be a vessel of Allah's blessings. This name further instills a sense of responsibility to bestow and share joys, love, and kindness among all beings. It is a constant reminder to shower kindness upon others and to be a source of comfort and solace in moments of need. Finally, by carrying this name, individuals are encouraged to strive towards becoming instruments of Allah's blessings and embodying the gentle and gracious aspects of character.
